status: research only; not promoted; no pass or fail threshold defined

units.clock: seconds of game clock. Regulation: game_seconds_remaining = (4 - quarter) * 900 + clock_seconds. Overtime is not validated against the simulator.
units.yardline_100: yards from the offense's opponent goal line, 0 to 100. 100 is the offense's own goal line.

drive_fields.name: drive_index
drive_fields.definition: 1-based position of the drive within its game, in game order. Counts non-offensive segments.

drive_fields.name: half
drive_fields.definition: 1 = quarters 1 and 2; 2 = quarters 3 and 4; OT = overtime.

drive_fields.name: start_quarter
drive_fields.definition: Quarter of the first offensive play. 5 = overtime.

drive_fields.name: offensive
drive_fields.definition: True when offense_plays > 0. The comparison population.

drive_fields.name: offense_plays
drive_fields.definition: Run, pass (including sacks), qb_kneel, qb_spike, punt and field_goal plays. Kickoffs, extra points, two-point attempts and no-play rows are not counted.

drive_fields.name: scrimmage_plays
drive_fields.definition: Run, pass (including sacks), qb_kneel and qb_spike plays.

drive_fields.name: yards_run_pass
drive_fields.definition: Sum of yards gained on run and pass plays. Sacks count as negative pass yards.

drive_fields.name: first_down_gained
drive_fields.definition: True when any run or pass play in the drive records a first down.

drive_fields.name: start_yardline_100
drive_fields.definition: yardline_100 at the first scrimmage play. Null when the drive has none.

drive_fields.name: score_diff_at_start
drive_fields.definition: Team score minus opponent score immediately before the first offensive play.

drive_fields.name: kickoff_to_end_seconds
drive_fields.definition: Clock at the drive's first timed row minus the end clock. Includes the kickoff when the drive starts with one.

drive_fields.name: possession_seconds
drive_fields.definition: Clock at the first offensive play minus the end clock. Excludes the kickoff. Provisional benchmark field.

drive_fields.name: end_clock_basis
drive_fields.definition: How the end clock was taken. The simulator's equivalent is the post-play clock of its last play (basis: post_play_clock_of_last_play).

drive_fields.name: points_for
drive_fields.definition: Points the drive's team scored while the drive was on. Touchdown 6, extra point 1, two-point try 2, field goal 3.

drive_fields.name: points_against
drive_fields.definition: Points the opponent scored while the drive was on. Defensive or return touchdown 6, the conversion after it, a defensive two-point try 2, a safety 2.

drive_fields.name: end_class
drive_fields.definition: How the drive ended. See end_class.

drive_fields.name: end_subtype
drive_fields.definition: Cause within the end class. Empty when the class has no subtype.

touchdown_scored.meaning: The drive's team scored a touchdown. Subtype is the play type of the scoring row.

touchdown_allowed.meaning: The opponent scored a defensive or return touchdown on this drive. Subtype is the cause of the return.

safety_allowed.meaning: The drive's team gave up a safety. Subtype is the play type of the row.

field_goal_made.meaning: Last offensive play was a made field goal.

field_goal_missed.meaning: Last offensive play was a missed or blocked field goal.

punt.meaning: Last offensive play was a punt that was not blocked.

blocked_punt.meaning: Last offensive play was a blocked punt.

interception.meaning: The drive's team threw an interception that ended the drive.

fumble_lost.meaning: The drive's team lost a fumble that ended the drive.

end_of_half.meaning: The drive ended at the end of the first half, from the transition field.

end_of_game.meaning: The drive ended at the end of the game, from the transition field.

kickoff_fumble_lost.meaning: Non-offensive: a kickoff return was fumbled and lost. Not in the offensive comparison.

onside_kick_lost.meaning: Non-offensive: the kicking team recovered an onside kick. Not in the offensive comparison.

no_offensive_play.meaning: Non-offensive: a kickoff segment with no scrimmage play and no other end evidence.

simulator_terminal_map._status: Proposed. Confirm on a worked example before use.
simulator_terminal_map.touchdown: touchdown_scored when points team equals offense team, otherwise touchdown_allowed. The export must also supply the subtype, which the simulator does not record yet.
simulator_terminal_map.field_goal_attempt: field_goal_made when field_goal_made is true, otherwise field_goal_missed.
simulator_terminal_map.punt: punt. Blocked punts are not modelled.
simulator_terminal_map.turnover: interception or fumble_lost, from the last play's event_type. The simulator's terminal does not separate them.
simulator_terminal_map.safety: safety_allowed. The team in the drive gave up the safety. Confirm the convention.
simulator_terminal_map.end_of_regulation: end_of_game. Confirm that this terminal is the game's last drive.

segmentation_rules: A drive starts at each change of possession and at each regulation half start.
A kickoff received starts a drive. A kickoff segment with no scrimmage play is a non-offensive drive.
A touchdown ends the scoring drive. The extra point or two-point attempt stays with that drive.
After a safety the team that gave it up kicks a free kick, so the team that scored receives the next drive.
possession_seconds starts at the first offensive play's clock, so the kickoff runoff is excluded.

comparison.report: Each metric with its n. Buckets below the minimum are flagged, not compared.
